name: Siponimod Fumaric Acid
summary: The drug Siponimod Fumaric Acid has no warning signs or problems listed from its own records, similar drugs, or FDA reports [1][2]. In estimates from a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a low score of 44 for liver concerns [M]. The same computer model also gave the drug a low score of 41 for heart concerns rather than using tests on people [M].
